title: HII FF(X) Patrol Frigate Program Progressing as Navy Considers Foreign Options
summary: VIRGINIA BEACH, Va. — Both U.S. and foreign designs for the next small-surface combatant are under consideration after the cancellation of the Constellation-class guided-missile frigate, the new head of the Navy’s shipbuilding enterprise said this week. A foreign design study is running in parallel with the development of HII Ingalls’ FF(X) Flight I patrol frigate, which was announced late last year following the Constellation cancellation, Portfolio Acquisition Executive Rear Adm. Casey Moton told an audience on Thursday at the American Society of Naval Engineers Fleet Maintenance and Modernization Symposium. Moton confirmed that the HII frigate had passed its critical design
